note: Shared AXN position ledger. Consumed by /api/register-symbolon via compare-and-swap and honored by scripts/mint_deposit.py next_hex_id(). A position is an address, not a verification: witnessed-unverified entries hold real positions pending byte verification.
sequence_authority: max(registry hex, this ledger) — the two allocators share one space and can never collide
invariant: ONE KERNEL, ONE POSITION. The witness endpoint dedupes against both the symbolon entries and the main registry's kernel index before allocating; the deposit pipeline refuses to mint a kernel the witness layer already positioned. The stamp is authority-independent and can be made offline by anyone — uniqueness is enforced at the allocation gate, the only place it can be.

position_width.designed_expansion: 6 hex digits (16^6 = 16,777,216) — NOT 5. The expansion skips five and goes to six because the hexagon is architectural: the Crimson Hexagonal Archive, the six-glyph checksum. A six-digit position beside a six-glyph kernel is the identifier rhyming with its own form — two hexads flanking the family. Five would be mere capacity; six is the designed state.
position_width.migration: backward-compatible: existing 4-digit positions remain valid (leading zeros implicit). Change is to the allocator zero-pad width in next_hex_id() and the ledger. Trigger when allocation approaches 0xF000-ish, leaving headroom for the cutover.
position_width.note: At current pace (~1,450 positions used) the runway is long. This is inscribed now so whoever nears the ceiling finds the end was designed, not discovered.
